title: 第7课 · 你家离公司远吗
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 7 — 你家离公司远吗 · Do you live far from your company

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家里 — At home

items.py: A: Dàwèi huílai le ma?
items.en: A: Is David back?

items.zh: B：没有，他还在教室学习呢。
items.py: B: Méiyǒu, tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.
items.en: B: No, he's still studying in the classroom.

items.zh: A：已经9点多了，他怎么还在学习？
items.py: A: Yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn duō le, tā zěnme hái zài xuéxí?
items.en: A: It's after nine. Why is he still studying?

items.zh: B：明天有考试，他说今天要好好准备。
items.py: B: Míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, tā shuō jīntiān yào hǎohāo zhǔnbèi.
items.en: B: There's an exam tomorrow; he says he has to prepare well today.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 去机场的路上 — On the way to the airport

items.py: A: Nǐ xiànzài zài nǎr ne?
items.en: A: Where are you now?

items.zh: B：在去机场的路上。你已经到了吗？
items.py: B: Zài qù jīchǎng de lùshang. Nǐ yǐjīng dàole ma?
items.en: B: On the way to the airport. Have you arrived?

items.zh: A：我下飞机了。你还有多长时间能到这儿？
items.py: A: Wǒ xià fēijī le. Nǐ hái yǒu duō cháng shíjiān néng dào zhèr?
items.en: A: I've got off the plane. How long until you get here?

items.py: B: Èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
items.en: B: I'll be there in 20 minutes.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在健身房 — In the gym

items.py: A: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?
items.en: A: Do you live far from your company?

items.zh: B：很远，坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢！
items.py: B: Hěn yuǎn, zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!
items.en: B: Very far — more than an hour by bus!

items.zh: A：坐公共汽车太慢了，你怎么不开车？
items.py: A: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē tài màn le, nǐ zěnme bù kāi chē?
items.en: A: The bus is too slow. Why don't you drive?

items.zh: B：开车也不快，路上车太多了！
items.py: B: Kāi chē yě bú kuài, lùshang chē tài duō le!
items.en: B: Driving isn't fast either — too many cars on the road!

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在路上 — On the way

items.zh: A：今天晚上我们一起吃饭吧，给你过生日。
items.py: A: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn ba, gěi nǐ guò shēngrì.
items.en: A: Let's have dinner together tonight to celebrate your birthday.

items.zh: B：今天？离我的生日还有一个多星期呢！
items.py: B: Jīntiān? Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu yí ge duō xīngqī ne!
items.en: B: Today? My birthday is more than a week away!

items.zh: A：下个星期我要去北京，今天过吧。
items.py: A: Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào qù Běijīng, jīntiān guò ba.
items.en: A: I'm going to Beijing next week, so let's celebrate today.

items.zh: B：好吧，离这儿不远有一个中国饭馆，走几分钟就到了。
items.py: B: Hǎo ba, lí zhèr bù yuǎn yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó fànguǎn, zǒu jǐ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
items.en: B: OK. There's a Chinese restaurant not far from here, a few minutes' walk.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (语气副词“还”: still)

items.py: Bā diǎn le, tā hái zài shuì jiào.
items.en: It's eight o'clock and he's still asleep.

items.py: Nǐ zěnme hái méi chī fàn?
items.en: Why haven't you eaten yet?

items.py: Tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.
items.en: He's still studying in the classroom.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (时间副词“就”: early, quick)

items.zh: 同学们七点半就来教室了。
items.py: Tóngxuémen qī diǎn bàn jiù lái jiàoshì le.
items.en: The students were in class as early as 7:30.

items.zh: 我坐飞机一个半小时就到北京了。
items.py: Wǒ zuò fēijī yí ge bàn xiǎoshí jiù dào Běijīng le.
items.en: By plane I got to Beijing in just an hour and a half.

items.py: Èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
items.en: I'll be there in only twenty minutes.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (A 离 B + distance)

items.py: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn.
items.en: My home is far from school.

items.py: Xuéxiào lí jīchǎng yǒu èrshí duō gōnglǐ.
items.en: The school is over 20 km from the airport.

items.zh: 离我的生日还有一个多星期呢！
items.py: Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu yí ge duō xīngqī ne!
items.en: My birthday is still more than a week away!

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (语气助词“呢”: emphasis)

items.py: Bā diǎn shàngkè, shíjiān hái zǎo ne.
items.en: Class is at eight — there's plenty of time.

items.zh: 医院离我们这儿还远呢。
items.py: Yīyuàn lí wǒmen zhèr hái yuǎn ne.
items.en: The hospital is still a long way from here.

items.zh: 坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢！
items.py: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!
items.en: By bus it takes over an hour!

items.py: Dàwèi zài nǎr xuéxí ne?
items.en: Where is David studying?

items.zh: 九点多了，大卫为什么还不休息？
items.py: Jiǔ diǎn duō le, Dàwèi wèi shénme hái bù xiūxi?
items.en: It's after nine — why isn't David resting yet?

items.zh: 坐公共汽车一个小时能到公司吗？
items.py: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yí ge xiǎoshí néng dào gōngsī ma?
items.en: Can you get to the company in an hour by bus?

items.zh: 公司离家很远，她为什么不开车？
items.py: Gōngsī lí jiā hěn yuǎn, tā wèi shénme bù kāi chē?
items.en: The company is far — why doesn't she drive?

items.zh: 今天不是她的生日，为什么她朋友要今天给她过生日？
items.py: Jīntiān bú shì tā de shēngrì, wèi shénme tā péngyou yào jīntiān gěi tā guò shēngrì?
items.en: It's not her birthday today — why does her friend want to celebrate today?
